question: The difference of between two positive number x and y (x > y) is 350. If 9.5% of x is equal to 16.5% of y then the sum of the two numbers x and y is :
solution:
Given:

The difference between two positive numbers x and y (x > y) is 350.

9.5% of x is equal to 16.5% of y.

Calculation:

According to the question,

x - y = 350 ....(1)

9.5% of x = 16.5% of y

⇒ 0.095x = 0.165y

⇒ x/y = 0.165/0.095

⇒ (x + y)/(x - y) = (0.165 + 0.095)/(0.165 - 0.095) (Using componendo-dividendo method)

⇒ (x + y)/350 = 0.26/0.07 (From 1)

⇒ (x + y)/50 = 26

⇒ (x + y) = 26 × 50

⇒ (x + y) = 1300

**∴ The value of (x + y) is 1300.**
